description:
General Purpose:
We’re seeking an AI & Automation Specialist to design, develop, and implement AI-powered and automation solutions that improve business processes and user experience. Working closely with the onshore team, this role will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, with a strong focus on solution development, integration, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid background in data science, AI, and automation, along with the ability to build reliable, secure, and practical solutions that address real business needs.
Position Summary, Responsibilities and Expectations:
* Collaborate with the onshore team to understand business requirements, use cases, and solution priorities.
* Translate functional requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI, machine learning, and automation solutions.
* Build prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to evaluate feasibility and demonstrate business value.
* Develop data processing workflows, predictive models, intelligent assistants, and automated business processes.
* Integrate AI and automation solutions with existing systems, databases, applications, and APIs.
* Prepare, clean, transform, and analyze data required for AI and automation use cases.
* Monitor solution performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve accuracy, reliability, and maintainability.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and technical validation before deployment.
* Follow established standards for data security, privacy, access control, and AI governance.
* Research and evaluate emerging AI, data science, and automation technologies that may benefit the organization.
* Contribute to reusable frameworks, components, and development best practices across AI and automation initiatives.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience in data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or process automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python and working knowledge of SQL.
* Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model development, testing, and deployment.
* Familiarity with generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, and API-based AI services.
* Experience developing integrations using REST APIs, web services, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
